readmeMarkdown:
# Antigravity Context Relay

[中文文档](README.zh-CN.md) **Stop Antigravity long runs from getting wiped mid-task by opaque native compaction, forgetting early constraints, and busting your prefix cache.** > **Author's Recommended Workflow:** > On current Antigravity builds (512k native auto-compaction budget), enable **Auto-continue (`continue`)**, set the trigger zone to **80%–90%** to force a clean handoff before native compaction fires, turn on the **Codex-style seamless template (`codex-seamless`)**, and pair with **Context Mode** while delegating heavy execution work to **subagents** so your main thread stays focused across multi-million-token tasks. Antigravity Context Relay is a **pure-local** context monitor, customizable dual-watermark handoff controller, multi-template prompt manager, and transcript search/slice MCP plugin for **Google Antigravity** (Desktop, `antigravity-ide`, and CLI `antigravity-cli`) that keeps **2M–3M+ cumulative token** workflows on track across clean ` (Part 2)` → `(Part 3)` continuation chains. ## Side Panel Preview <table> <tr> <th align="center">Context Monitor & Dual Watermark</th> <th align="center">Chain History & FTS5 Recall</th> </tr> <tr> <td align="center"><img src="assets/screenshot-monitor.png" alt="Context Relay Monitor Side Panel (Gemini 4 Neon)" width="380"></td> <td align="center"><img src="assets/screenshot-history.png" alt="Context Relay Chain History and FTS5 Search Side Panel" width="380"></td> </tr> <tr> <th align="center">Settings & 3 One-Click Scenario Presets</th> <th align="center">Prompt Templates & Chain Inheritance</th> </tr> <tr> <td align="center"><img src="assets/screenshot-settings.png" alt="Context Relay Settings and Scenario Presets Side Panel" width="380"></td> <td align="center"><img src="assets/screenshot-templates.png" alt="Context Relay Prompt Templates Editor Side Panel" width="380"></td> </tr> </table> ## Installation ### Option 1: From GitHub Release Archive (No Git Required) 1. Download and extract the latest `.zip` / `.tar.gz` archive from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/WintAsuka/antigravity-context-relay/releases). 2. Open a terminal inside the extracted folder and run: ```bash # Install English edition into ~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-relay node scripts/install.mjs # Or install Chinese edition (UI, rules, skills, prompt templates, and (续N) naming) node scripts/install.mjs --lang zh ``` ### Option 2: From Source (`git clone`) ```bash git clone https://github.com/WintAsuka/antigravity-context-relay.git cd antigravity-context-relay # Install English edition (default) or add --lang zh for Chinese node scripts/install.mjs ``` Useful installer flags: - `--lang en|zh`: Select initial language (`en` by default). - `--link`: Create a Unix symlink instead of copying files (for local development). - `--uninstall`: Cleanly remove the installed plugin from `~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-relay` while keeping your `~/.gemini/context-relay/` history and config intact. > [!NOTE] > On Windows, Antigravity Desktop's Go plugin scanner may skip directory junctions created by `--link`. Use the default copy install (`node scripts/install.mjs`) for Windows Desktop. ### Option 3: Antigravity CLI (`agy`) ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/WintAsuka/antigravity-context-relay ``` To verify plugin manifests and runtime health offline before or after installation: ```bash node scripts/doctor.mjs --strict ``` Restart Antigravity Desktop, enable **Context Relay** in Customizations, and open **Context Relay** in the right side pane (`AUX_PANE`). ## Why Context Relay (vs. Native Compaction) | Dimension | Antigravity Native Compaction | Antigravity Context Relay | |---|---|---| | **Handoff Threshold** | Hard-coded policy caps per model profile (often 128K / 256K / 512K) that frequently ignore custom overrides. | Fully user-controlled **Soft Advisory → Hard Takeover** zones (default `80% – 90%`) or single-point caps via side panel or `config.json`: `%` of `request_budget_tokens`, `%` of native window, fixed token range, and per-model overrides (`modelOverrides`). | | **Summary Prompt Freedom** | Locked internal prompt templates (some profiles delegate summarization to smaller models or inject self-limiting rules against re-reading files or running `git diff`). | 5 built-in scenario presets (including `codex-seamless`) + unlimited custom templates in `~/.gemini/context-relay/prompts/`, editable in the side panel, selectable via `/handoff <template>`, and inherited across `(Part N)` / `(续N)` chains. | | **History & Lineage Protection** | Evicts raw tool outputs from active history; repeated compactions cause `summary(summary)` drift until early decisions are lost. | Never mutates raw transcripts. Persists full lineage in `~/.gemini/context-relay/chains.json` and exposes `handoff_timeline`, `handoff_list_chain`, `handoff_search_chain`, `handoff_search`, and `handoff_slice` MCP tools (guarded by `PreToolUse`). | | **Prefix Cache & Cost Behavior** | Rewrites earlier prompt history in-place mid-session, invalidating prefix caches (`cache_read_tokens → 0`) and triggering blind re-read loops. | Keeps prefix append-only and cache-stable within each generation; rolls over cleanly at your chosen watermark with exact file/line maps and warm-cache lineage tracking. | | **Long-Horizon Relay** | Can stall mid-loop or drift off constraints after repeated inline checkpoints. | Detects crossings mid-task (`PreInvocation`) or at turn end (`Stop`), writes an anchored handoff packet, spawns `<Title> (Part N)` inheriting title/model/project/permissions, and dispatches the continuation prompt immediately. | ## Key Features - **Zero External Dependencies**: Pure Node.js ESM (`>=20`, SQLite decoding via built-in `node:sqlite` on Node 22.5+, automatic `transcript.jsonl` fallback on older runtimes). No Python required, no `npm install`. - **3 One-Click Scenario Presets in Settings**: Switch workflows instantly at the top of the **Settings** tab without editing JSON: - **Observer Only**: Threshold alerts and telemetry only (`mode: "remind_only"`), never auto-creates continuation sessions. - **Seamless Relay**: Fast, compact continuation (`seamlessMode: true`, `codex-seamless` brief) while preserving `(Part N)` / `(续N)` lineage. - **Structured + Auto-Archive**: Full structured handoff summary, automatic archiving of previous generations (`autoArchivePrevious: true`), and native compaction fallback (`handoffOnCompacted: true`). - **Live Context Monitor & Session Telemetry / Quota Card**: - **100-dot 1% usage grid**, 14-category breakdown, checkpoint status, context file list, CLI-compatible `Copy as text`, live handoff watermark bar, lineage pill strip, and one-click `/handoff`. - **2×2 Telemetry & Quota Card**: Session-wide **cumulative Prompt Cache hit rate** (`Σ cache_read / Σ (uncached + cache_write + cache_read) × 100%`) as the headline and totals alongside a 12-turn sparkline, latest + session-average TPS/TTFT with an estimated 5-minute cache warmth countdown, model quota bar with reset timer, and public-rate API cost/savings estimate. - **Warm Handoff Lineage Metrics**: Records `seedTokens`, `modelInherited`, and `cacheWarmAtHandoff` per generation in `chains.json`, warns on model fallback (`cacheWarning`), and displays `~seed` and `Warm relay` badges in **Chain History**. - **Zero-Lag Dual-Watermark Detection (`PreInvocation` + `Stop`)**: - `lib/context-report.mjs` counts newly completed `PLANNER_RESPONSE` and tool outputs after the latest `gen_metadata` snapshot for zero-lag tail accounting. - **Soft Advisory → Hard Takeover** (default `80% – 90%`): Entering the soft zone nudges the agent once (without interrupting mid-step edits) to wrap up cleanly; crossing the hard threshold enforces takeover immediately via `PreInvocation` (mid-loop) or `Stop` (final reply). Set soft equal to hard for single-point triggering. - **5 Built-in Summary Templates & Chain Inheritance**: - `default` (general anchored handoff), `coding-strict` (repo state, contracts, test outputs, dead ends), `research-writing` (research questions, outline, verified URLs), `creative-rp` (world rules, character states, plot threads), and `codex-seamless` (~400–1,000-word fast brief with anti-re-read anchors). - Create, clone, edit, and delete unlimited custom templates in `~/.gemini/context-relay/prompts/`. Binding a template to a conversation (side panel or `/handoff <template>`) propagates automatically to `(Part 2)`, `(Part 3)`, … - **Lossless Cross-Generation Recall (MCP + `PreToolUse` Guard)**: - Blocks unbounded full-file reads of `transcript*.jsonl` via `PreToolUse`. - Exposes `handoff_timeline`, `handoff_list_chain`, `handoff_search_chain`, `handoff_search`, and `handoff_slice` via `mcp/history-server.mjs`, backed by an incremental SQLite FTS5 index (`lib/history-index.mjs`) and visual **Chain History** explorer. - **Isolated Subagent Relay (`subagentMode: "codex_relay"`)**: Subagents hand off through flat parent-mediated sibling relays in an isolated subagent sequence (`scripts/subagent-relay.mjs`) without cluttering your main chat list. - **Clean English / Chinese Isolation & One-Click Switch**: Separate static manifests (`locales/en/` vs `locales/zh/`), templates (`prompts/` vs `prompts/zh/`), and sidecar locales (`sidecars/handoff/locales/{en,zh}.json`). Toggle anytime with `ZH` / `EN` in the top bar or install with `--lang zh`. - **Decoupled State & Automatic Legacy Migration**: All user data lives in `~/.gemini/context-relay/` outside the plugin directory; existing `~/.gemini/auto-handoff/` data migrates non-destructively on first run. Supports `antigravity` (Desktop), `antigravity-cli`, and `antigravity-ide`. ## Recommended Pairings - **Antigravity Desktop**: Combine **Context Mode** (stops huge command/file dumps in-session) + **Context Relay** (monitors real token budgets, cache hit rate, and hands off cleanly before native compaction amnesia). - **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)**: Can also be paired with **billion-context** (`bili antigravity`) for in-session incremental pruning, using Context Relay as the outer cross-session handoff layer. ## Configuration (`~/.gemini/context-relay/config.json`) User settings live in `~/.gemini/context-relay/config.json` and per-session trigger state lives in `~/.gemini/context-relay/state.json`. Edit them visually in the **Settings** tab or directly in JSON: | Field | Default | Description | |---|---|---| | `language` | `"en"` | `"en"` (`(Part N)` titles) or `"zh"` (`(续N)` titles) | | `mode` | `"continue"` | `"continue"` (auto-create continuation chat) or `"remind_only"` (notify only) | | `thresholdMode` | `"budget_ratio"` | `"budget_ratio"`, `"limit_ratio"`, or `"fixed"` | | `softBudgetRatio` | `0.8` | Soft advisory ratio (`0.1` – `1.0`, `<= budgetRatio`); set equal to `budgetRatio` for single-point triggering | | `budgetRatio` | `0.9` | Hard takeover ratio (`0.1` – `1.0`) in ratio modes | | `fixedSoftThresholdTokens` | `160000` | Soft advisory token threshold when `thresholdMode` is `"fixed"` | | `fixedThresholdTokens` | `200000` | Hard takeover token ceiling when `thresholdMode` is `"fixed"` | | `fallbackThresholdTokens` | `200000` | Fallback if neither budget nor limit can be resolved | | `minThresholdTokens` | `80000` | Minimum threshold floor for ratio-based budgets | | `retriggerDeltaTokens` | `30000` | Cooldown token delta before re-triggering hard takeover in the same session | | `handoffOnCompacted` | `false` | Trigger immediate handoff fallback if native compaction (`compacted=true`) is detected (disabled by default to avoid hijacking older pre-compacted threads) | | `seamlessMode` | `false` | Codex-style seamless mode (`codex-seamless` brief when global template is `default`, minimal UI callouts, keeps `(Part N)` / `(续N)` titles) | | `autoArchivePrevious` | `false` | Archive the previous conversation via `UpdateConversation` after continuation creation and chain persistence succeed | | `subagentMode` | `"codex_relay"` | `"codex_relay"` (flat parent-mediated sibling relay), `"skip"`, or `"standard"` | | `skipSubagents` | `false` | Legacy boolean kept synchronized with `subagentMode === "skip"` | | `modelOverrides` | `{}` | Map of model ID/name pattern -> number or `{ "soft": N, "hard": M }` | Environment overrides (backward-compatible with `AUTO_HANDOFF_*`): - `CONTEXT_RELAY_DISABLE=1`: Fail-open disable of Context Relay hook checks and transcript read blocks. - `CONTEXT_RELAY_SUBAGENT_MODE`: Override `subagentMode` (`codex_relay`, `skip`, or `standard`). - `CONTEXT_RELAY_DATA_DIR`: Override the user state directory (defaults to `~/.gemini/context-relay`). - `CONTEXT_RELAY_THRESHOLD` / `CONTEXT_RELAY_SOFT_THRESHOLD`: Force an explicit numeric threshold or `"soft-hard"` range (e.g., `"120000-150000"`). - `CONTEXT_RELAY_DRY_RUN=1`: Evaluate threshold without writing `state.json`. - `CONTEXT_RELAY_RECENT_USER_CHARS`: Character budget for verbatim recent user excerpts in seamless mode. ## Privacy & Safety - **100% Local Execution & Zero External Telemetry**: All token decoding, FTS5 indexing, hook evaluation, and UI rendering run locally on your machine. Nothing is uploaded to external servers (the sidecar only queries Antigravity's local `127.0.0.1` Language Server when fetching model catalogs and quota). - **Never Modifies Host Global Config**: Installation and language switching only operate within `~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-relay` and `~/.gemini/context-relay/` — never overwriting Antigravity's global `~/.gemini/config/config.json`. - **Non-Destructive Transcript Policy**: Raw `transcript.jsonl` / `transcript_full.jsonl` files and Antigravity SQLite `.vscdb` / `.pb` databases are strictly read-only. - **Clean Uninstall & Auto-Redacted Diagnostics**: Remove cleanly anytime via `node scripts/install.mjs --uninstall`. When troubleshooting, `node scripts/doctor.mjs` automatically redacts home paths and tokens before output. ## FAQ & Troubleshooting <details> <summary><strong>1. The side panel doesn't appear or stays Idle / Waiting for connection?</strong></summary> 1. Confirm Antigravity was restarted after running `node scripts/install.mjs` and **Context Relay** is enabled in Customizations. 2. On Windows Desktop, ensure you did **not** install with `--link` (use the copy install `node scripts/install.mjs`). 3. Open or send at least one message in a conversation so Antigravity writes active conversation state, then run `node scripts/doctor.mjs` to inspect discovered directories and sidecar health. </details> <details> <summary><strong>2. I'm on Node 20 — why is live token breakdown or Prompt Cache data missing?</strong></summary> Antigravity stores live `gen_metadata` and step tables in SQLite. Built-in `node:sqlite` became available in **Node.js 22.5+**. On Node 20, Context Relay automatically falls back to estimating tokens from `transcript.jsonl` so handoffs still work, while fine-grained SQLite telemetry (14-category breakdown, Prompt Cache hit rate, and TTFT/TPS) requires **Node 22.5+** (or Antigravity's bundled runtime). </details> <details> <summary><strong>3. Does Context Relay conflict with <code>antigravity-plugin-context-mode</code>?</strong></summary> No — they are designed to complement each other. **Context Mode** intercepts and compacts oversized tool outputs inside a single session, while **Context Relay** guards `PreToolUse` against unbounded `transcript*.jsonl` full reads and handles cross-session handoff when the overall conversation budget approaches your watermark. </details> <details> <summary><strong>4. How do I diagnose an issue or file a bug report quickly?</strong></summary> Run: ```bash node scripts/doctor.mjs ``` (Or `node scripts/doctor.mjs --strict` to verify plugin manifests.) The output is auto-redacted for home directories and sensitive values, ready to paste into the [Bug Report template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml). </details> ## Testing & Contributing ```bash node tests/run-tests.mjs node scripts/doctor.mjs --strict ``` For contributors editing `locales/en/*`, run `npm run sync-locales` to keep root `plugin.json`, `rules/AGENTS.md`, and `skills/handoff/SKILL.md` byte-for-byte identical to `locales/en/*` (or `node scripts/sync-locales.mjs --check` to verify). ## Credits & Attribution - The live context protobuf decoder (`lib/context-report.mjs`) and the Context Monitor panel layout (`sidecars/handoff/main.mjs`, `sidecars/handoff/handlers.mjs`, `sidecars/handoff/ui/*`) are ported to Node.js and adapted from **[antigravity-desktop-context](https://github.com/dimitr-io/antigravity-desktop-context)** by **Dimitrios Ioannidis** (MIT License). ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
latestReleaseNotes:
### English Release Notes

**Antigravity Context Relay v2.2.0** adds live session-wide Prompt Cache & model quota telemetry, warm-handoff lineage tracking, 3 one-click scenario presets in Settings, an offline diagnostic & strict manifest validator (`scripts/doctor.mjs`), and a full README + visual overhaul.

#### Highlights

- **Session-Wide Prompt Cache & Telemetry/Quota 2×2 Card**:
  - Decodes live per-turn and cumulative prompt cache hit rates (`Σ cache_read / Σ (uncached + cache_write + cache_read) × 100%`), TTFT, streaming TPS, estimated 5-minute cache warmth TTL, model `quotaInfo` remaining fraction + reset countdown, and public API-equivalent cost/savings in `lib/context-report.mjs` and the Context Monitor side panel.
  - Displays a 12-turn prompt cache trend sparkline with an `i` formula popover.
- **Warm Handoff Lineage Metrics**:
  - `scripts/handoff.mjs` and `lib/chains.mjs` now track `seedTokens`, `modelInherited`, and `cacheWarmAtHandoff` across every `(Part N)` / `(续N)` generation, emit `cacheWarning` on model fallback, and surface `~seed`, `Warm relay`, and `Model fallback · cold` badges in **Chain History**.
- **3 One-Click Scenario Presets in Settings**:
  - Quickly switch between **Observer Only**, **Seamless Relay**, and **Structured + Auto-Archive** directly at the top of the **Settings** tab.
- **Safer New-User Default (`handoffOnCompacted: false`)**:
  - Prevents unexpected mid-thread takeover when opening older already-compacted sessions (can still be enabled in Settings or via **Structured + Auto-Archive**).
- **Offline Diagnostics & Strict Manifest Check**:
  - Run `node scripts/doctor.mjs` for an auto-redacted diagnostic report ready for bug reports, or `node scripts/doctor.mjs --strict` to validate plugin manifests offline in alignment with `agy plugin validate --strict`.
- **Docs, 4-Tab Screenshots & Community Assets**:
  - Added full 4-tab static side panel screenshots (`Gemini 4 Neon`, 512k budget / 1M window), `1280×640` GitHub social preview (`assets/social-preview.png`), structured `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` forms, Release archive install steps, plus Privacy & Safety and FAQ sections in `README.md` / `README.zh-CN.md`.

#### Quick Upgrade / Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/WintAsuka/antigravity-context-relay.git
cd antigravity-context-relay
node scripts/install.mjs          # English (default)
# or: node scripts/install.mjs --lang zh
node scripts/doctor.mjs --strict  # Verify installation & manifests
```

---

### 中文发布说明（v2.2.0）

**Antigravity Context Relay v2.2.0** 正式带来全会话 Prompt Cache 与模型配额遥测面板、热接力谱系指标、设置页三大一键场景预设、自动脱敏诊断与清单校验工具（`scripts/doctor.mjs`），以及全新的产品级文档与演示动图。

#### 本次更新亮点

- **全会话累计 Prompt Cache 与 2×2 遥测/配额卡片**：
  - 在 `lib/context-report.mjs` 与侧边栏「上下文监控」中实时解析并展示**全会话累计缓存命中率**（`Σ cache_read / Σ (uncached + cache_write + cache_read) × 100%`）及最近 12 轮趋势柱状图、最新/均值 TPS 与首字延迟（TTFT）、5 分钟热窗倒计时估算、模型剩余配额与重置倒计时，以及公开 API 等效费用与缓存省钱估算。
- **热接力谱系指标**：
  - `scripts/handoff.mjs` 与 `lib/chains.mjs` 在每次换代时记录 `seedTokens`、`modelInherited` 与 `cacheWarmAtHandoff`；若发生模型回退会给出 `cacheWarning`，并在「历史链」面板展示 `~seed`、`Warm relay` 与冷启动回退徽章。
- **设置页顶部 3 套一键场景预设**：
  - 在侧边栏「交接设置」顶部一键切换 **仅观察提醒（Observer Only）**、**无感极速接力（Seamless Relay）** 与 **结构化归档（Structured + Auto-Archive）**。
- **更稳妥的新用户默认配置（`handoffOnCompacted: false`）**：
  - 默认关闭原生压缩即刻劫持，避免在打开已压缩过的历史旧会话时误触发（可在设置页或「结构化归档」预设中开启）。
- **离线自检与严格清单校验工具**：
  - 运行 `node scripts/doctor.mjs` 一键生成自动脱敏诊断报告（可直接粘贴至 GitHub Issue）；运行 `node scripts/doctor.mjs --strict` 进行对齐 `agy plugin validate --strict` 的离线清单校验。
- **文档、4 页高清实拍与社区资产完善**：
  - 换装 4 页静态高清侧边栏截图（`Gemini 4 Neon` 512k 预算 / 1M 窗口实景）、`1280×640` GitHub Social Preview（`assets/social-preview.png`）、标准化 Issue 模板（`.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`），并在中英文 README 置顶推荐工作流与 Release 包安装说明，补全「隐私与安全承诺」与「常见问题排查（FAQ）」。

#### 快速安装与升级

```bash
git clone https://github.com/WintAsuka/antigravity-context-relay.git
cd antigravity-context-relay
node scripts/install.mjs --lang zh   # 中文版（桌面端推荐）
node scripts/doctor.mjs --strict     # 校验清单与运行环境
```
